search.title: Search invoices by number or customer name
search.body:
Adds a `q` parameter to `GET /invoices` that searches invoice numbers and customer names (case-insensitive, partial match). `%` and `_` in the search term are matched literally. The total count uses the same filter, so pagination stays right.

Example: `GET /invoices?q=INV-00012` returns INV-000120 to INV-000129.

overdue.title: List overdue invoices for payment reminders
overdue.body:
Adds `GET /invoices/overdue`: invoices that are past their due date and haven't been paid, oldest first, paginated like the other lists.

The payment-reminder job will page through this endpoint to decide who gets a reminder email.

unique-email.title: Make customer emails unique, case-insensitive
unique-email.body:
- Adds a unique index on `lower(email)`.
- Stores emails lower-case.
- `POST /customers` and `PATCH /customers/:id` return 409 when the email is already taken.

finish-cents.title: Finish moving invoice amounts to cents
finish-cents.body:
Finishes moving invoice amounts to integer cents, so we stop doing float math on money.

- Backfills `amount_cents` for existing invoices and makes it `NOT NULL`.
- Every invoice response returns `amount_cents` instead of `amount`.

New invoices already write `amount_cents` (since the `add_invoice_amount_cents` migration).
